# MADFAM CV (working label) — ai-portfolio-builder

> A job-specific CV and portfolio builder from Innovaciones MADFAM, incubating, in an invite-only private beta: one
> core profile, the jobs a person applies to, and a tailored CV, portfolio and presentation per job. One container
> serves four hosts routed by Host: cv.madfam.io (landing, es-MX and en; noindex until the brand is ruled),
> cv-app.madfam.io (the app; Janua sign-in, invite-only accounts gated in Janua), cv-api.madfam.io (/api/v1/meta and
> the owner-scoped API on Postgres) and cv-p.madfam.io (the pages people choose to publish). /health and /ready
> answer on any Host. The old code remains in the history up to commit 7959f356. No open sign-up, AI or prices yet.

Boundary: public repository. Operational detail lives in MADFAM's private ops repository under the
repo-boundary contract (docs/REPO_BOUNDARY.md).

## Invariants

- One Enclii project and one Service, both `cv`; container port 3000, Service port 80, every domain `port: 80`.
- The host table is data (apps/web/src/lib/config.ts); exact Host matches; unknown Host is a 404.
- Identity is Janua, money is Dhanam, LLMs only through Selva, deploy is Enclii, analytics self-hosted Plausible only.
- No invented proof, no prices, no secrets in the tree; madfam.io is the only MADFAM domain.
- Every data row is owned by a Janua `sub`; repository functions take ownerSub first; other owners' ids are 404.
- Sign-in and data are configured in production; wherever their settings are missing they answer 503 not_configured
  (dormant by default).
- Public repo CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners; every action is SHA-pinned; Build & Deploy is dispatch-only.
- The fourth host, cv-p.madfam.io, serves user pages (public /<slug>, link-shared /l/<token>; CV_HOST_PAGES, inert
  wherever it is unset); per-page indexing is the page owner's choice, link pages are never indexed or cached.
- App pages are declared once (apps/web/src/lib/app-routes.ts): /, /perfil, /empleos, /empleos/nuevo,
  /empleos/capturar, /empleos/:id, /empleos/:id/adaptar, /documentos, /documentos/:id, /documentos/:id/vista-previa,
  /documentos/:id/imprimir, /ajustes (en under /en); all of them are built.
- Job intake (W5-J) never stores before the person confirms; links are fetched once, only on an explicit POST, through
  an SSRF guard that respects robots.txt and never fetches boards whose terms forbid it (those use the person's own
  browser capture). No crawling, no login to boards, no AI, no OCR engine in cv (images go to tlacuilo, built and
  dormant).
- W6-A: the pages host is cv-p.madfam.io (owner-approved; CV_HOST_PAGES set in production; live). Unauthenticated reads (pages host, cv-api /api/v1/public/*) are rate limited per client
  (CF-Connecting-IP only, token bucket 60 + 60/min per pod, 429 with Retry-After). Sign-in sessions expire after 7 days
  without use. cv.madfam.io/lector (es-MX) and /en/lector explain the job-link reader; its User-Agent links there.

## Code

- `apps/web/`: @cv/web, Next.js 16 App Router; `src/proxy.ts` routes by Host; `src/lib/` holds the pure routing, header, robots and config logic
- `Dockerfile`, `infra/k8s/production/`, `enclii.yaml`, `.github/workflows/build-deploy.yml`: the one image, its kustomize base, the Enclii manifest, the dispatch-only build caller
- `apps/web/src/server/`: Janua token verification, the Drizzle schema and owner-scoped repository, the API handler
- `apps/web/src/server/metrics*.ts`: observability; `/metrics` on the internal port 9090 only (never a public host), route-template labels, JSON request logs without PII
- `apps/web/drizzle/`: committed SQL migrations; `apps/web/test-pg/`: the real-Postgres cross-owner suite
- `janua.client.yaml`: Janua registrations (names only: resource server `cv-api`, confidential client `cv-app`)
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/`, `src/components/app/`, `src/lib/client/`, `src/lib/copy/`: UI primitives, the app frame, the typed data layer, per-surface copy
- `apps/web/e2e/`: Playwright specs over the built server (two owners, local JWKS, throwaway Postgres)
- `apps/web/src/server/read-limit.ts`: W6-A per-client token bucket on unauthenticated reads; `src/lib/copy/reader.ts` and `src/app/h/landing/[locale]/lector/`: the reader page
- `apps/web/src/server/ingest/`, `src/components/jobs/intake/`: W5-J job intake (link, ATS public APIs, paste, PDF/DOCX/HTML files, browser capture) and its typed job fields (migration 0002)
- `apps/web/src/server/hcm/`, `src/components/jobs/benchmark/`: W5-H, the job page's market income range from Symbiosis HCM (INEGI ENOE official statistics; only the job title and state leave cv; live in production, dormant wherever `HCM_*` is missing)
- `apps/web/src/server/ingest/closed.ts`, `src/components/profile/SectorGuide.tsx`, `e2e/luxury.spec.ts`: W7 (B3), the luxury-retail beta: luxury career sites read through their JSON-LD/microdata only when robots.txt allows (no undocumented APIs), closed postings refused honestly, the retail guide in the profile, es/en versions per job, the «Búsqueda confidencial» reminder before sharing
- `apps/web/src/server/hcm/route.ts` `RETAIL_SALES_SINCO`, `src/components/jobs/benchmark/SegmentSection.tsx`: W7, the retail industry segment beside the general ENOE figure for store sales and store management jobs (HCM `segment=retail_apparel_personal`, labelled «no solo lujo»)

- `apps/web/src/lib/profile-text.ts`, `src/components/render/localize.ts`, `e2e/bilingual.spec.ts`: W7 (B4), bilingual profile text: one primary language per profile, the other optional field by field in a nullable `translations` jsonb (migration 0003); documents print their own language and fall back to the primary text with a «Faltan N textos en inglés» flag (preview and tailoring only); language names from ISO 639 codes; no machine translation

- `apps/web/src/components/onboarding/`, `src/lib/copy/onboarding.ts`, `src/lib/ui-locales.ts`: B1, the first-run guide on the app home (empty profile → import or by hand, then the first job; private by default) and the `ui_locales` cv sends Janua; beta access is invite-only in Janua (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md "Beta access")
